basic_details.short_information: Gurukula Kangri (Deemed to be University) (गुरुकुल कांगड़ी (समविश्वविद्यालय)), Haridwar, will hold a walk-in interview on 4 December 2026, reporting from 11:00 AM at its Main Campus, Haridwar (Uttarakhand)-249404. content_sections.heading: About GKV
content_sections.text: Gurukula Kangri (Deemed to be University) is located at Haridwar, Uttarakhand. This notice invites applications for teaching posts in its self-financed (SFS-2020) Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences. It is issued in compliance with the order of the Hon'ble High Court, Nainital (Uttarakhand) in WPSP No. 671 dated 03-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post: Assistant Professor (5 posts, male) in Pharmaceutics / Pharmaceutical Chemistry / Pharmacology / Pharmacognosy, at the Main Campus. The posts are on contract (अनुबन्ध) for 23 months. The notice does not print the degree or experience itself. It asks candidates to study the Pharmacy Council of India Regulations, 2014 and the SFS Rules-2020 carefully before applying. Candidates should check the official notification and those Regulations for the discipline-specific eligibility.

rows.post: Assistant Professor (Pharmaceutics / Pharmaceutical Chemistry / Pharmacology / Pharmacognosy)
rows.qualification: Educational qualification and experience as per Pharmacy Council of India Regulations, 2014
rows.pay: Rs. 40,000 (forty thousand rupees only), as per SFS Rules-2020

content_sections.heading: Application Fee and Bank Details
content_sections.text: Applicants for the teaching posts must pay an application fee of Rs. 800 online into the bank account below. The fee receipt must be brought to the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Interested candidates should fill in the Application Form available on the university website www.gkv.ac.in . They then attend the walk-in interview on the date and time given above. Application forms are not accepted by any other means.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Completely filled Application Form, downloaded from www.gkv.ac.in Educational certificates, with self-attested photocopies and the originals Experience certificates Receipt of the fee deposited All documents and certificates in original, plus one photocopy of each

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the GKV Assistant Professor walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 04-12-2026 from 11:00 AM at the Main Campus of Gurukula Kangri (Deemed to be University), Haridwar (Uttarakhand)-249404.

faq.question: Q2. How many Assistant Professor posts are vacant at GKV?
faq.answer: There are 5 posts in the Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences. The university may reduce or increase this number.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for GKV Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Educational qualification and experience are as per the Pharmacy Council of India Regulations, 2014, as stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of GKV Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 40,000 (forty thousand rupees only) as per SFS Rules-2020.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 800 for teaching posts. It is paid online into the Punjab National Bank account given in the notice, and the receipt must be brought to the interview.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the GKV walk-in?
faq.answer: Fill in the Application Form from www.gkv.ac.in and attend the walk-in interview. The university does not accept application forms by any other means.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring the filled form, educational certificates (self-attested photocopy and original), experience certificates and the fee receipt. All documents must be in original, with one photocopy of each.

faq.question: Q8. Is the GKV Assistant Professor job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is on contract (अनुबन्ध) basis for 23 months under the self-financed scheme.

faq.question: Q9. Can women apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The notice lists the 5 posts for male candidates (पुरुष).

faq.question: Q10. Will GKV send a separate call letter for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice says no separate intimation will be given for the walk-in interview.
